test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some notebooks are pencils.

All pencils are bags.

All bags are bottles.

**Conclusions:**

(I) All pencils are bottles.

(II) Some bags are notebooks.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0dceff6a085ebedae79d6bded88411662dc76d5e4f0274afc8f6744c8a5d5cf.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All pencils are bottles → Follows (As all pencils are bags and all bags are bottles so, it is definite that all pencils are bottles.)

(II) Some bags are notebooks → Follows (As some notebooks are pencils and all pencils are bags so, it is definite that some bags are notebooks.)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusions I and II follows".**
